title: Species known in 1692, by John Ray's count, and described species in 2026 (log scale)
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale, in pairs. Beasts and serpents: Ray, about 150; 2026, 28,497 mammals, reptiles and amphibians. Birds: Ray, about 500; 2026, 11,185. Fishes, without shellfish: Ray, about 500; 2026, 37,630. Insects and other bloodless animals: Ray, about 20,000 on the whole earth; 2026, 1,008,355 insects. Plants: Ray, more than 18,000; 2026, 401,452 land plants. Ray's figures are from The Wisdom of God, second edition, 1692; the 2026 figures are the IUCN Red List's Table 1a, version 2026-1, summed by kloom.
heading: SPECIES · RAY'S COUNT, 1692, AND DESCRIBED BY 2026 · LOG SCALE

source.container: John Ray, The Wisdom of God Manifested in the Works of the Creation, 2nd ed. (London, 1692), pp. 6–10; IUCN Red List version 2026-1, Table 1a
